items.originalTitle: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
items.summaryEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix. The collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1以全新汤米·希尔费格系列在美国大奖赛上尽显得克萨斯风情
凯迪拉克与汤米·希尔费格发布了一个以得克萨斯为灵感的五件式牛仔（denim）系列
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——图片由汤米·希尔费格提供
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队及其合作伙伴汤米·希尔费格在奥斯汀美国大奖赛前发布了一个德克萨斯主题的服装系列，这让我们所有人都兴奋不已。
汤米·希尔费格与凯迪拉克一级方程式车队的奥斯汀系列于本周二早些时候开售。但这并不是这两个品牌第一次推出与比赛相关的产品。他们已经在同一城市系列中推出了迈阿密和墨西哥系列，并且还计划在11月推出拉斯维加斯系列。
不出意外的话，牛仔布是这些单品的核心，它们带有镀铬细节和汤米·希尔费格红白蓝配色的V形美国国旗。
男士可以购买基于经典卡车司机风格的浅色水洗牛仔夹克。女士则有一件带银色箔涂层的牛仔背心。一件T恤、一件背心和一顶牛仔帽让这个系列更加让人难以拒绝。你知道还有什么同样让人难以拒绝吗？可以看到凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯在日落时分向镜头举起一顶牛仔帽，背上印有V形旗帜图案。
你还需要什么来说服你？
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——由汤米·希尔费格提供
“在我们的美国根源上增添一点乐趣”
汤米·希尔费格首席设计官李·霍尔曼表示，设计师们从该品牌最受欢迎的两件单品入手。
他说：“我们从 Tommy 衣橱中的标志性单品——牛仔夹克和白 T 恤——入手，并研究了如何以奥斯汀的城市气质为灵感对它们进行重新演绎。”
“关键在于把熟悉的单品赋予全新的视角，同时坚守我们经典美式酷感的品牌基因。”
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队首席品牌顾问卡西迪·托里斯表示，在得克萨斯州举行的这场比赛让两个品牌都有了发挥空间。
“奥斯汀让我们有机会在美国根源上玩得更尽兴一些，”托里斯说，“这是为比赛周末打造的粉丝服饰，但设计上力求在围场之外也能长久穿着。”
汤米·希尔费格是凯迪拉克的官方服装和车迷服饰合作伙伴，车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯——博塔斯的队友——也是该品牌的全球男装大使。奥斯汀站是美国车队本赛季继五月初迈阿密大奖赛之后的第二个主场比赛，佩雷斯期待能在离家更近的地方驾驶。
“我们距离能够与前车竞争还差大约一秒到一秒半，我认为我们现在真正需要的是一辆更强的赛车，”佩雷斯在新加坡站后表示。“其他一切都在按预期推进，我相信我们作为一个团队会达到目标。我非常期待奥斯汀和墨西哥，我们的两场主场比赛。
“奥斯汀是车队的主场，墨西哥对我而言将格外特别，在家乡观众面前比赛并迎来第300场大奖赛。那将是一个非常特别的周末。”
凯迪拉克在首个赛季仍在等待它的首个积分。
detailEn: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
Cadillac and Tommy Hilfiger have unveiled a five-piece denim collection inspired by Texas
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix in Austin, and it's making us all kinds of excited.

The Tommy Hilfiger x Cadillac Formula 1 Team Austin collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week. But this isn't the first time the two brands have released something in connection with a race. They have already released Miami and Mexico collections in the same city series, and a Las Vegas drop is also planned for November.
Denim, maybe unsurprisingly, is the heart of these pieces, which carry chrome detailing and a chevron-shaped American flag in Tommy Hilfiger's red, white and blue.

Men can buy a light-wash denim jacket based on the classic trucker style. For women, there's a denim vest with a silver foil coating. A T-shirt, a tank top and a denim cap make the range even harder to say no to. And do you know what else does the same? Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas can be seen tipping a cowboy hat to the camera at sunset, with the chevron flag design across his back.
What more do you need to persuade you?
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
"A little more fun with our American roots"
Lee Holman, Tommy Hilfiger's chief design officer, said the designers started with two of the brand's most popular pieces.
"We started with icons of the Tommy wardrobe – the denim jacket and the white T-shirt – and looked at how we could rework them inspired by the character of Austin," he said.
"It's about taking familiar pieces and giving them a fresh point of view, while staying grounded in our classic American cool DNA."
Cassidy Towriss, chief brand adviser for the Cadillac Formula 1 Team, said the race in Texas gave both brands room to play.
"Austin gives us a chance to have a little more fun with our American roots," Towriss said. "It's fanwear made for race weekend, but designed to live well beyond the paddock."

Tommy Hilfiger is Cadillac's official apparel and fanwear partner, with driver Sergio Perez, Bottas's team-mate, also the brand's global menswear ambassador. With the Austin race being the American team's second home race of the season after the Miami Grand Prix earlier this season in early May, Perez is looking forward to driving a little closer to home.

“We are still lacking around one to one-and-a-half seconds to be able to compete with the cars ahead, and I think what we really need now is a stronger car underneath us," Perez said following his Singapore campaign. "Everything else has been progressing as expected, and I’m confident we will get there as a team. I’m really looking forward to Austin and Mexico, our two home races.
"Austin for the team, and Mexico will be particularly special for me, racing in front of my home crowd and reaching 300 grands prix. It’s going to be a very special weekend.”
Cadillac is still waiting for its first points in its debut season.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯分享了约舒亚·杜尔肯森与巴拉圭总统之间的情感通话
约舒亚·杜尔肯森在成为该国首位测试现代一级方程式赛车的车手后，收到了巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳的电话
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克莱利和布里克斯沃斯的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
梅赛德斯分享了巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳给发展车手约舒亚·杜尔肯森打电话祝贺他首次参加一级方程式测试的时刻
“一个非常特别的电话。巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳确保祝贺乔什第一次参加F1赛事。这对国家来说是一个自豪的时刻，”梅赛德斯在视频通话的片段旁边发布了这条消息。
“这个片段来自一部幕后视频，名为《梅赛德斯内部：约书亚·杜尔肯森的第一次F1测试，巴拉圭，我们做到了！》，这是Brackley团队在本周早些时候发布的。
“这位22岁的年轻人两天前在波尔蒂马奥驾驶梅赛德斯W16赛车，这辆赛车在2025年锦标赛中由乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利驾驶。
“这对杜尔肯森来说是一个重要的时刻，这也是第一位驾驶现代F1赛车的巴拉圭车手。‘传奇！这太棒了，伙计，’总统佩纳在电话中对杜尔肯森说。‘约书亚，我真的很兴奋。这是你的梦想，也是我的梦想，是数百万巴拉圭人的梦想，我们都为你的成就感到自豪。我们梦想中的那个巨大的巴拉圭，就是你。’
Durksen在视频中补充道：“从一个许多人认为我们是一个小国家，也许我们无法做很多事情的国家，到达到赛车运动的顶峰，驾驶F1赛车……我认为这是一个明确的信息，特别是对我的同胞来说，我们被允许做梦，我们可以做大梦，我们可以实现这些梦想。”
我认为在驾驶之后，我甚至更加热爱这项运动，而且这肯定是我想要长期从事的事情。
粉丝们分享了他们对巴拉圭车手的激动之情。
一个粉丝评论道：“对整个巴拉圭来说是多么自豪的事情！加油，约书亚，如果你能做到的话！！！！”另一个粉丝补充说：“约书亚太棒了，我希望他们能尽快给他一个F1的座位。”
detailEn: Mercedes shares emotional call between Joshua Durksen and Paraguay president
Joshua Durksen received a call from Paraguayan president Santiago Peña after becoming the first driver from his country to test a modern F1 car
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes has shared the moment Paraguay's president, Santiago Pena, phoned development driver Joshua Durksen to congratulate him on his first Formula 1 test.
"A very special call. Santiago Pena, president of Paraguay, made sure to congratulate Josh on his first F1 run. A proud moment for the country," Mercedes posted alongside footage of the video call.
The clip comes from a behind-the-scenes video, Inside Mercedes: Joshua Durksen's First F1 Test, Paraguay, We Did It!, that was released by the Brackley outfit earlier this week.
The 22-year-old spent two days at Portimao at the wheel of the Mercedes W16, which was raced by George Russell and Kimi Antonelli in the 2025 championship.

Not only was it a big moment for Durksen, but it was also the first time a driver from Paraguay had driven a modern F1 car. "Legend! That's huge, man," president Pena told Durksen on the call. "Joshua, I'm really excited. This is your dream, it's my dream, it's the dream of millions of Paraguayans who truly are proud of everything you're accomplishing. That giant Paraguay we all dream about, it's you."

Durksen added in the video: "To come from a country that many people think we're a small country, and that maybe we cannot do a lot of stuff, to reaching the top of motorsport and driving a Formula 1 car... I think it's a clear message, especially to my people, that we are allowed to dream, that we can dream big and that we can accomplish these dreams.
"I think after driving, I'm even more in love with this sport, and for sure this is something I want to do for the very long term."
Fans shared their excitement for the Paraguayan driver.
"What pride for all of Paraguay! Let's go, Joshua, if you can!!!!" one fan commented, while another added: "Joshua is so great, I want them to give him a seat in F1 soon."

items.originalTitle: Mercedes reveals why it rejected the Macarena wing over a year ago
items.summaryEn: Mercedes deputy technical director Simone Resta revealed that the team evaluated the rotating "Macarena" rear wing concept more than a year ago but ultimately decided against it.
detailZh: 梅赛德斯解释为何一年多前放弃马卡雷纳尾翼
梅赛德斯副技术总监西蒙娜·雷斯塔透露，车队一年多前就评估过旋转式尾翼概念
致梅赛德斯车迷：来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
梅赛德斯F1车队早在竞争对手将其投入赛道使用之前，就研究过自建马卡雷纳尾翼。但据副技术总监西蒙娜·雷斯塔表示，车队最终决定不采用。
这种旋转翼——当赛车切换至直线模式时，其主翼片会翻转——在当前这一规则时代已成为非常显眼的创新。法拉利最先采用这一想法，并被称为“玛卡arena翼”，红牛也在迈阿密带来了自己的版本。迈凯伦——我们已看到其在测试自己的版本——表示将在未来某个时候让其一战。
梅赛德斯是四大车队中唯一尚未对此类设计表现出兴趣的车队。如今，雷斯塔在车队自己的最新一期《银箭电台秀》节目中解释了原因。
“我大概要说一些我们之前没有分享过的事情：大约一年多以前，我们的绘图板上就有这种翼了，”雷斯塔说。“我们一直在相当详细地评估这个概念，它显然在降低阻力方面带来了好处，但在你操作开缝模式（Open SM）的每一节练习与排位中，也会带来下压力的减少。
“这是我们评估过的东西。这是我们从未觉得在平衡上是最佳整体折衷方案的东西，可以说，所以值得在研发以及制造部件等方面进行投入。但这并不意味着同样的结论永远有效，我们可能会在今后重新审视我们的观点和立场。
“所以我们当然保持谦逊，逐一检查现有的所有方案，评估是否有任何对我们有价值、值得采纳的东西，并让这个迭代过程持续下去。”
梅赛德斯到目前为止在没有该尾翼的情况下依然应对自如。车队以578分领跑车队积分榜，领先法拉利134分；进入美国大奖赛比赛周时，安东内利领先队友拉塞尔102分。
不过，重点是在此前于新加坡站将升级分配给两位车手之后，把新升级带到两辆车上。安东内利使用了新升级，而拉塞尔测试了旧版本。车队领队托托·沃尔夫此后确认，新部件将在美国站出现在两辆车上。
detailEn: Mercedes reveals why it rejected the Macarena wing over a year ago
Mercedes deputy technical director Simone Resta reveals the team evaluated the rotating rear wing concept more than a year ago
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Mercedes Formula 1 team looked at building its own Macarena rear wing long before it was seen running on a circuit by a rival outfit. But according to deputy technical director Simone Resta, it decided against it.

The rotating wing, whose main flap turns over when a car switches into straight-line mode, has become a very visible innovation so far in this current era of regulation. Ferrari was first to run the idea with it being coined the Macarena wing, and Red Bull brought its own version to Miami. McLaren, who we have seen testing its own, has said it will race one at some point in the future.
Mercedes is the only one of the top four teams yet to show an interest in such a design. Now, Resta has explained why on the latest episode of the team's own Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show.

"I am probably going to say something we have not shared before: we had this kind of wing on our drawing board a bit more than a year ago," Resta said. "We've been evaluating this concept quite in detail and it's clearly offering a benefit in drag reduction, but it's also coming with a reduction of downforce in every session you operate the Open SM.

"And it's something that we evaluated it. It's something that we never felt in balance to be the best overall compromise, let's say, so worth, let's say, investing in terms of development and also making components, etc. But it doesn't mean that the same conclusion is valid forever and we might revisit our view and our position going forward.
"So we are, of course, humble, checking every solution that is out there, evaluate if there's anything interesting for us to pick up and keep this iterative process going forward."

Mercedes has managed without the wing so far. The team leads the constructors' championship on 578 points, 134 clear of Ferrari, and Kimi Antonelli is 102 points ahead of team-mate George Russell as they go into the race week of the United States Grand Prix.

The focus is, however, on bringing the new upgrade to both cars after it was previously split between the drivers in Singapore. Antonelli used the new upgrade while Russell tested the older version. Team principal Toto Wolff has since confirmed the new components will be seen on both cars at the American race.

视频是由粉丝账号MV3daily在比赛之夜发布的。视频中，可以看到迈凯轮车手与哈斯一级方程式车手Ollie 贝尔曼一起外出，人群中有人举着一个写着"给最佳车手"的牌子。
视频中，诺里斯大声喊道"兰斯在哪里，兰斯在哪里？"，许多F1粉丝认为这是对阿斯顿·马丁车手的讽刺。
斯特罗尔本赛季还没有得分，今年成为首位达到100次Q1淘汰的车手。
分享视频的账号在其帖子中对诺里斯进行了批评。MV3daily写道："兰斯可能不是赛道上最好的车手，但至少要有一些尊严。"
在撰写本文时，该帖子已有330万次观看，约19,000个赞和564条回复。其中一条回复获得了超过5,000个赞，开玩笑说：“兄弟们的公关经理正在为他们的生命而战” [原文如此]。
辩论变得非常激烈，以至于后来账号要求粉丝冷静下来。
“我们能不能都放松一点，这里每个人都太过于激进，这都表现出来了，”MV3daily在第二天发布了以下内容。
诺里斯和斯特罗尔都没有对这段视频做出回应。
视频出现在世界冠军艰难周末的结尾。在周六的冲刺赛中，诺里斯和他的队友奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一圈的5号弯道发生碰撞，争夺第四名。皮亚斯蒂退赛，而诺里斯恢复到第八名，因此麦凯轮车队在红牛车队逼近车队 constructors' championship 第三名的时候只得到了一分。
诺里斯在随后的周日承认说：“这是我的错误，我让团队失望了。我也向他们所有人道歉，我欠他们一个道歉，我下次会做得更好。”
诺里斯以第四名的成绩完成了大奖赛，落后获胜者马克斯·维斯塔潘40.5秒。诺里斯现在在积分榜上排名第六，积分为201分，而麦凯轮车队在车队 constructors' championship 中领先红牛车队七分，前往德克萨斯州。
下一场比赛是10月23日至25日在奥斯汀举行的美国大奖赛。
detailEn: Lando Norris sparks controversy after appearing to mock Lance Stroll in viral video
The McLaren driver has sparked debate among F1 fans after a viral video shows what appeared to be him making a joke at Lance Stroll's expense
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

A video is doing the rounds on social media, appearing to show Lando Norris mocking Lance Stroll on a night out after the Singapore Grand Prix. It's now been viewed more than three million times on X.

The clip was posted by the fan account MV3daily on the night of the race. In it, the McLaren driver is seen out with Haas Formula 1 driver Ollie Bearman while someone in the crowd raises a sign saying "To the best driver".
In the footage, Norris shouts "Where's Lance, where's Lance?", which many F1 fans took as a dig at the Aston Martin driver.
Stroll has yet to score a point this season and this year became the first driver to reach 100 Q1 eliminations.
The account that shared the video was critical of Norris in its post. "Lance may not be the best driver on the grid but have some decency atleast," MV3daily wrote.
At the time of writing, the post had 3.3 million views, around 19,000 likes and 564 replies. One reply, with more than 5,000 likes, joked: "bros PR manager is fighting for their life" [sic].
The debate became heated enough that the account later asked followers to calm down.
"Can we all relax a little bit, everyone is a little bit too aggressive on here and it's showing," MV3daily posted the following day.
Neither Norris nor Stroll has responded to the clip.

The video came at the end of a difficult weekend for the reigning world champion. In Saturday's sprint, Norris and team-mate Oscar Piastri were fighting for fourth when they collided at Turn 5 on the last lap. Piastri retired while Norris recovered to eighth, so McLaren left with one point at a time when Red Bull is closing in on third place in the constructors' championship.
"It was a mistake on my part, and I let down the team. I've also apologised to all of them, I owe them all an apology, and I will do better next time," Norris conceded on the following Sunday.

Norris finished the grand prix fourth, 40.5 seconds behind winner Max Verstappen. Norris now sits sixth in the standings on 201 points, and McLaren heads to Texas just seven points ahead of Red Bull in the constructors' championship.
The next race is the United States Grand Prix in Austin, from 23 to 25 October.

items.originalTitle: Nicki Thiim's cheeky F1 jab: "Max Verstappen just wants to drive a proper race car!"
items.summaryEn: Aston Martin veteran Nicki Thiim took a cheeky jab at Formula 1 while commenting on Max Verstappen's guest appearance at the GT World Challenge Europe season finale in Portimao. He referenced F1's struggles with its 2026 power unit regulations, which feature a 50:50 power split between the internal combustion engine and electric power.
detailZh: 尼克·蒂姆调侃F1：“马克斯·维斯塔潘只想开一辆真正的赛车！”
GT3明星车手回应维斯塔潘在波尔蒂芒3小时赛中的意外亮相
阿斯顿·马丁老将尼克·蒂姆借马克斯·维斯塔潘在GT世界挑战赛欧洲杯波尔蒂芒收官战中的客串亮相，对F1进行了一番调侃。
F1在2026年动力单元规则上的困境已被广泛报道，该规则要求内燃机与电力各占50%的动力分配，而2027年及以后的规则调整也已列入计划。
然而就目前而言，F1必须忍受针对这些赛车的调侃，而维斯塔潘本人正是批评得最激烈的人之一。
蒂姆驾驶与马蒂亚·德鲁迪和罗斯·冈恩共享的7号Comtoyou Racing阿斯顿·马丁Vantage GT3赛车，排位赛获得第九名，他将对F1的抨击融入对这位四届世界冠军的高度赞扬之中。
“显然，他能来这里真是太棒了。我喜欢他的赛车心态——他就是想出去比赛，不惜一切代价，无论手里拿到什么车，”这位丹麦人说道。
“他大概是想开一辆真正的赛车，而不是他一直开着转悠的那些电动车！”
他能来参加最后一轮比赛真是太好了，显然这对我们所有人都有好处。我预计会有很多年轻人非常感兴趣并密切关注。
以这样的赛道结束赛季真是太棒了，而且显然我们自己还要为年度亚军的位置而战，所以一场重要的比赛即将到来。
整个围场里，车手和车队人员都表达了同样的看法，欢迎维斯塔潘的参赛为GTWC欧洲赛带来的前所未有的关注——这项赛事本就以高水平的职业GT3竞争和激烈比赛而闻名，但一直难以吸引主流关注。
宝马厂队车手乔丹·佩珀与谢尔顿·范德林德和查尔斯·维茨一同驾驶32号WRT宝马M4 GT3 Evo赛车，从第14位起步，他也表达了类似的赞赏。
这位南非车手表示：“我非常尊重马克斯。他来这里和我们一起参加GT世界赛，其实没什么可获得的。这也恰恰说明了我们所处的水平。”
“在我看来，无论他参加什么赛事，他都是我们这一代中最优秀的。他在纽博格林今年的表现就证明了这一点。”
“但他能利用一个空闲周末来参加GT赛事，并让我们这里的比赛获得真正的关注，这真的很酷。这个系列赛每年都在不断壮大。就在你觉得它已经不能再好的时候，竞争却变得更加激烈。”
波尔蒂芒的三小时比赛定于当地时间周六下午5点开始，届时将有61辆GT3赛车组成的参赛阵容角逐赛季收官战。
detailEn: Nicki Thiim's cheeky F1 jab: "Max Verstappen just wants to drive a proper race car!"
GT3 stars react to Verstappen's surprise appearance in the Portimao 3 Hours
Aston Martin veteran Nicki Thiim has used Max Verstappen’s guest appearance at the GT World Challenge Europe season finale in Portimao to take a cheeky jab at Formula 1.

F1's struggles with its 2026 power unit regulations, featuring a 50:50 power split between the internal combustion engine and electric power, have been well documented, with rule changes already planned for 2027 and beyond.
For now, however, F1 must endure the banter directed at the cars, which Verstappen himself has been among the most vocal in criticising.
Thiim, who qualified ninth in the #7 Comtoyou Racing Aston Martin Vantage GT3 he shares with Mattia Drudi and Ross Gunn, blended his F1 swipe into high praise for the four-time world champion.
"Obviously, it's super nice that he's here. I love his racing mindset - he just wants to go out there and race whatever it takes, whatever he gets his hands on," the Dane said.
"He probably wants to race a proper race car, not those electric things that he's been running around with!"
"It's super nice to have him here for the final round, and obviously it's good for all of us. I expect a lot of young people will be super interested and watch it closely.
"What a track to end the season on, and obviously we have a position to fight for second place in the championship ourselves, so an important race is coming up."

Across the paddock, drivers and team personnel echoed the sentiment, welcoming the unprecedented spotlight Verstappen’s entry brings to GTWC Europe - a championship already renowned for its high level of professional GT3 competition and fierce racing, but which has struggled to attract mainstream interest.
BMW factory driver Jordan Pepper, who starts 14th in the #32 WRT BMW M4 GT3 Evo alongside Sheldon van der Linde and Charles Weerts, shared similar praise.
"I have huge respect for Max. He's really got nothing to gain here, coming to play with us in GT World. It also just shows the level that we're at," the South African said.
"In my opinion, he's the best of our generation, no matter what he jumps into. He showed that at the Nurburgring with what he did this year.

"But it's just really cool that he's taking an off weekend, coming to GT, and putting a real spotlight on what we have here. The series goes from strength to strength every year. Just when you think it can't get any better, the competition gets even higher."
The three-hour race at Portimao is scheduled to start on Saturday at 5:00 PM local time, with a 61-car GT3 grid set to tackle the season finale.

Former F1 driver Daniel Ricciardo is embarking on a road trip from Ford's Raptor Rally in Arizona to Austin for the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo is taking on an intense road trip across America, starting in the Arizona desert for Ford's Raptor Rally this weekend and ending in Austin, Texas, for the United States Grand Prix.

Ford Racing and Ricciardo's lifestyle brand Enchanté announced his participation in the event in a joint Instagram post. "Raptor Rally, you ready? We’re rolling out with Daniel Ricciardo to hit the trails. See you out there!" the caption read.

According to Ford, 1000 guests and more than 450 trucks gathered in Lake Havasu, Arizona, for the third edition of the Raptor Rally. Over two days, there are desert trails, Baja loops, hot laps with professional drivers and the first Raptor Baja Sprint competition.
Included in the line-up are Loren Healy, Brad Lovell, Vaughn Gittin Jr and Mitch Guthrie Jr.
Enchanté and Ford Racing are opening a pop-up at Distribution Hall, 1500 East 4th Street, Austin, from 22-25 October.

Following his F1 exit in 2024, Ricciardo became a global ambassador for Ford Racing. During his time in the role, he has spent time behind the scenes at Ford's global facilities, become the face of the Raptor brand, taken part in various events with the Ford Raptor T1+ and been involved with the Red Bull F1 car reveal event as part of its new power unit collaboration with Ford.

items.originalTitle: Red Bull explains how AI is influencing its F1 race strategy
detailZh: 红牛解释了AI如何影响其F1赛事策略
红牛透露，与Oracle合作开发的AI驱动的赛事策略工具正在帮助车队在大奖赛期间做出决策。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔、法拉利、马克斯·维斯塔潘、红牛车队
对于红牛车迷来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的赛事分析。
红牛车队正在使用一套人工智能系统，在大奖赛期间为车队提供行动建议。
在CNBC的一次采访中，红牛技术及性能合作伙伴负责人杰克·哈林顿解释说，该工具是与头号合作伙伴甲骨文共同开发的。
这个工具最初是一个搜索工具，帮助工程师解读F1的规则和过去的裁决，现在已经发展成为一个"代理"人工智能，它利用更多信息并在比赛中提供行动建议。
哈林顿解释说："它实际上在为我们做决策。"
Oracle和红牛车队在2026年2月宣布了他们之间多年冠军合作伙伴关系的延长。米尔顿凯恩斯的车队在当时发布的新闻稿中解释说："延长的合作伙伴关系建立在车队传统的基础上，Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)和Oracle AI支撑着红牛福特动力系统下一代混合动力单元的2026年首秀，先进的赛车策略模拟和开创性的AI驱动策略代理。"
哈灵顿以2025年意大利大奖赛为例，展示了AI代理的工作方式。在蒙扎赛道比赛的第一个弯道，维斯塔潘在与麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯争夺领先时冲出了赛道。根据哈灵顿的说法，代理建议红牛车队放弃位置以避免处罚。
尽管这个建议与车队对局势的看法相悖，但红牛车队还是遵循了指示。维斯塔潘避免了处罚，很快从麦克拉伦车手那里夺回了领先，并以19.2秒的优势赢得了比赛。
哈灵顿补充说，"一级方程式赛车始终是人类的运动"，但他解释说，AI代理可以帮助提升车队。
红牛并非唯一使用人工智能的车队。谷歌正在与迈凯轮合作引入其Gemini人工智能工具，梅赛德斯与微软合作，法拉利则与IBM合作，为粉丝提供人工智能驱动的体验。
detailEn: Red Bull explains how AI is influencing its F1 race strategy
Red Bull has revealed how an AI-powered race strategy tool developed with Oracle is helping the F1 team make decisions during grands prix
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Red Bull is using an artificial intelligence system that recommends actions to the team during a grand prix.
During an interview with CNBC, Red Bull head of technical and performance partnerships Jack Harington explained that the team built the tool with its title partner, Oracle.
What began as a search tool to help engineers interpret F1's regulations and past rulings has since become an "agentic" AI that draws on more information and recommends actions during a race.
"It’s actually making decisions for us," Harington explained.

Oracle and Red Bull announced a multi-year extension of their title partnership in February 2026. The Milton Keynes outfit explained in the press release at the time: "The extended partnership builds on the team’s legacy, with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and Oracle AI underpinning the 2026 debut of Red Bull Ford Powertrains’ next-generation hybrid power unit, advanced race-strategy simulations, and a pioneering AI-powered strategy agent."

Harington used the example of the 2025 Italian Grand Prix to show how the AI agent works. On the opening lap of the race at Monza, Verstappen went off at the first chicane while fighting McLaren's Lando Norris for the lead. According to Harington, the agent advised Red Bull to hand the place back to avoid a penalty.

While that recommendation went against the team's view of the situation, Red Bull followed the instruction. Verstappen escaped a penalty, soon retook the lead from the McLaren driver and won the race by 19.2 seconds.
Harington added that "Formula 1 is and will always be a human sport", but explained that the AI agent can help enhance the team.

Red Bull is not the only team using AI. Google is working with McLaren to bring its Gemini AI tools, Mercedes has partnered with Microsoft and Ferrari is working with IBM on AI-powered experiences for fans.

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen unveils special Texas-themed helmet for F1 United States GP
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘为美国大奖赛揭晓特别德克萨斯主题头盔
马克斯·维斯塔潘为美国大奖赛揭晓了特别设计的德克萨斯主题头盔
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说。关注红牛车队，获取F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯赛道上的比赛分析。
四次F1世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘为美国大奖赛揭幕了一款特别头盔，在美洲赛道比赛前，对他的常规设计进行了奥斯汀，德克萨斯州的改造。
荷兰人已在社交媒体上揭幕了新设计。"即将前往德克萨斯州。我将带着这顶特别的头盔来到奥斯汀！"他发布了新头盔的详细照片。
The主要的变化是在头盔顶部的狮子，现在它戴着一顶牛仔帽。狮子在白色背景上以蓝色突出，整个头盔都保留了红、白、蓝的主题。
截至写作时，维斯塔潘的帖子已经获得了超过747,000个赞。一位粉丝评论道："10分满分 - 戴着牛仔帽的狮子太棒了，"另一位补充说："戴着牛仔帽的狮子太棒了哈哈哈。
其他反应包括："哦，这太美了，"和"头盔真是太可爱了。"
为了配合新的头盔，维斯塔潘和他的红牛车队队友伊萨克·哈德贾也将穿着特别的全白色复古风格的赛车服。新的设计在粉丝中激起了希望，希望米尔顿凯恩斯车队能在奥斯汀的比赛中引入全白色的涂装，但这尚未得到确认。
维斯塔潘在马来西亚巴林大奖赛和新加坡大奖赛连续获胜后，将前往奥斯汀。他目前在车手积分榜上排名第四，积分为221分，落后积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利119分。
但大多数车手在经历了紧张的连续三站赛事后都会有一周的休息时间，而维斯塔潘本周将在波尔蒂马奥的GT世界挑战赛欧洲决赛中驾驶维斯塔潘赛车队的#3号奔驰-AMG赛车，与克里斯·卢尔汉和本·巴尼科特一起参赛。
美国大奖赛将于10月23日至25日在美国赛车场举行，并开启了锦标赛下个三站赛事，紧接着是墨西哥和巴西大奖赛。
detailEn: Max Verstappen unveils special Texas-themed helmet for F1 United States GP
Max Verstappen has unveiled a special Texas-themed helmet for the United States Grand Prix
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has revealed a special helmet for the United States Grand Prix, giving his usual design an Austin, Texas, makeover ahead of the race at the Circuit of the Americas.
The Dutchman unveiled the new design on social media. "Texas bound. I’ll be coming to Austin with this special helmet!" he posted alongside detailed photos of the new helmet.

The main change is to the lion on the top of the helmet, which now wears a cowboy hat. The lion stands out in blue on a white background and the red, white and blue theme has been retained throughout the whole helmet.

At the time of writing, Verstappen's post had already received more than 747,000 likes. "10s across the board - the lion with the cowboy hat is incredible," one fan commented, while another added: "The lion in the cowboy hat is brilliant haha."
Further reactions included: "Oh this is gorgeous", and "Simply lovely that helmet."

To complement the new helmet, Verstappen and his Red Bull team-mate Isack Hadjar will also be wearing special all-white, vintage-style race suits. The new designs have sparked hope among fans that the Milton Keynes outfit could introduce an all-white livery for the race in Austin, but this is yet to be confirmed.

Verstappen heads to Austin after back-to-back wins at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia and the Singapore Grand Prix. He currently sits fourth in the drivers' standings with 221 points, 119 points behind championship leader Kimi Antonelli.

But while most drivers have a weekend off from racing after an intense triple-header, Verstappen is racing in the GT World Challenge Europe finale at Portimao this weekend in the Verstappen Racing #3 Mercedes-AMG with Chris Lulham and Ben Barnicoat.

The United States Grand Prix takes place at the Circuit of the Americas from 23-25 October and kicks off the next triple-header in the championship, with the Mexican and Brazilian Grands Prix in the two weeks following.
